Triage: routed `domain:identity` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts`); hold as `finding` stands — the filer's own reasoning is the grade: two measured incident codes is thin ground for a predicate that changes the response shape of every better-auth route at once, and the generalization ("any engine error carrying a 4xx `status` maps to the matching `APIError`" — consuming what the producer already declares) needs the blast-radius inventory the card specifies before it is dispatchable.

Restart conditions: (a) a **third** bodyless-500 incident of this class — at that point the enumeration approach is measurably losing to the general rule and this promotes with the incident as evidence; (b) the identity lane doing the inventory (which engine codes reach this seam, what status each declares, does any route rely on a fault staying unmapped) — with that in hand this becomes a normal queue card.

Triage (findings round): graded — **held** as `finding`.

Why held: nothing is broken today; two measured incidents are thin ground for a predicate that remaps every better-auth route at once, and the card's own blast-radius checklist (inventory of reachable engine codes, check that no route relies on a fault staying unmapped, predict-then-mutate ablation) is real work that should be bought when the evidence is thicker. The contract-first direction ("any engine error carrying a 4xx `status` maps to the matching `APIError`" — consume what the producer declares) is recorded and agreed as the shape when it is taken up.

Re-grade trigger, binding: **a third incident of this shape — any engine code reaching a better-auth route as a bodyless 500 — promotes this card to `pm:queue` as a Bug immediately**, with the generalisation (not another single-code arm) as the scope. Two arms was defensible narrowness; a third would be enumerating a producer contract downstream, which is the drift this repo's rules exist to stop.

## Closed `not_planned`: the hold waits for a third incident that has not come

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T16:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim. The finding stays valid as a record.

**Provenance:** **who** — the maintainer; **verbatim** — 「同意」, answering the triage seat's on-hold cleanup plan (which named this card and this disposition); **where** — the maintainer's chat with the triage session `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f`, 2026-09-27.

- `rethrowAsBetterAuthError` maps engine errors code by code, so an unmapped code surfaces as a bodyless 500. The hold's own trigger is 「a third bodyless-500 incident of this class is reported」. None has been reported since 2026-08-12.
- The maintainer's own words on the cheaper form of deferral (objectstack-ai/objectstack#19458): 「an open card is read by every sweep, a closed one costs nothing and stays searchable」.

**Reopen is free** on that trigger: a third incident of the class, named. The scope is then the generalisation this card already names (a 4xx status maps to `APIError`), not another single-code arm.
